snippet.title: Starship Command - Orion Spur - June Trailer
snippet.description:
Presenting the first gameplay trailer for Starship Command: Orion Spur. 

We can't wait to share more with you as the team churns away. 

Coming soon: Gameplay video from the bridge, where you issue orders to your officers to control the Leonidas. 

This trailer focuses on the external direct control mode. 

Enjoy! 

Don't forget to like/subscribe, and join our discord - link in the comments!

- SCOS Team
